title: The levels of the work, each with its name

schema.description: the schema of this file, from the root of the repo (formats.md, section Schemas)

type.description: what this file holds (formats.md, section The head of a file)

key.description: the key of the level, as the field level of a file names it, such as r5 or r5tc

part.description: the parts that use the level: the product, our process and tools, or both

stands_for.description: of a level of our process and tools: the level of the product it stands for, such as r2 for tool

name.description: what the level is called, such as software requirements or subsystem test

abbreviation.description: the short form of the name, such as SR or SwVal; none where the level has none

description.description: what the level holds, or what its tests test

reference.description: the clause of a standard the level follows, or the term the standard gives it

data.description: of a test level: the data its tests run with
